title: Register with MyCTSavings or certify a retirement plan exemption
description: Private employers with five or more employees (at least five earning $5,000 or more in the prior year) and no qualified plan must offer MyCTSavings or certify an exemption on the portal. Deadlines moved from March 30, 2023 to August 31, 2023 and then annual; the current date was not confirmed. A 2023 law-firm alert found no penalty for failing to certify.

appliesWhen.description: 5 or more employees in the state

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)

title: Train employees on sexual harassment prevention
authority: Connecticut Commission on Human Rights and Opportunities
description: Employers with three or more employees must give two hours of training to all employees within six months of hire, and to supervisors regardless of employer size; supplemental training is required periodically (sources say every 10 years or every three).

appliesWhen.description: 3 or more employees in the state
